species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 55°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–20 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 35 ft, cold below.
Northwest wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
